A range of intelligent cameras
for power line monitoring

Fixed camera

Baseline continuous monitoring of a chosen stretch of the grid.

Multi-lens camera

360° panoramic coverage — no blind spots at all.

PTZ camera

Controlled pan and powerful zoom for detailed coverage of wide areas.

Thermal camera

High-precision detection of overheating and thermal anomalies, preventing failures.

A camera mounted directly on the conductor

Our company's key autonomous solution for hard-to-reach sections.
Live-line installation: mounted without switching the line off.
Fully self-powered: inductive supply straight from the phase conductor.
Total control: continuous real-time monitoring of line condition.
Smart analytics: onboard artificial intelligence and integrated sensors.
Modules and smart sensors
that can be integrated:
LiDAR — 3D clearance measurement and scanning of encroaching trees.
Micro weather station — local monitoring of weather conditions.
Ice and vibration sensors — early warning of physical load on the grid.
Edge AI — processing on the device itself for instant alerts.

AI diagnostics: the threats it finds
and the problems it solves

Problems solved
Risk to personnel

Work at height, on live lines, in hazardous areas.

Harsh environment

Enormous length, mountains, snow, wind and heat.

Blind spots

No real-time monitoring and no single picture of grid condition.

Defects detected
Hardware defects

Corrosion, broken conductors, cracked or shattered insulators, overheated joints.

External threats

Foreign objects on the lines, unpermitted construction inside the right of way.

Vegetation and wildlife

Encroaching vegetation, bird nests, the aftermath of wildfires.

Up to 80% of grid components are classified by the platform fully automatically
